prompt: Agents can operate freely on feature branches but require human approval before merging to release. Which pattern is this?
explanation: Tiered autonomy: maximum freedom in low-risk zones, targeted gates at high-risk boundaries. This balances velocity with control without blocking routine work.

options.text: Disable guardrails on feature branches and block all changes to release
Tiered autonomy — full agent autonomy in low-risk zones (feature branches); mandatory human approval at the high-risk transition (merge to release)
Block agents from all branches uniformly
Allow direct agent push to release for maximum speed
